mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (user_id, item_type, item_id, content, parent_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.item_type = #{itemType} AND c.item_id = #{itemId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
SELECT c.*, u.name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
